description: This file defines the UserService class in the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing user-related operations such as creating, retrieving, deleting users, handling passwords, and roles within the administrative module.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service class handling user management functions such as creating, retrieving, deleting users, password verification, and role management within the OrangeHRM admin module.

methods.name: geUserDao
methods.description: Returns the UserDao object, initializes it if not set.

methods.name: getPasswordHasher
methods.description: Returns the PasswordHash object, initializes it if not set.

methods.name: saveSystemUser
methods.description: Saves a user object to the system, hashing the password if provided.

methods.name: getSystemUser
methods.description: Retrieves a system user by user ID.

methods.name: deleteSystemUsers
methods.description: Performs a soft delete of users based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Retrieves a UserRole object based on role name.

methods.name: getSearchSystemUsersCount
methods.description: Returns the count of users matching search filter criteria.

methods.name: searchSystemUsers
methods.description: Searches for users based on filter parameters.

methods.name: isCurrentPassword
methods.description: Checks if the provided password matches the current user's password.

methods.name: getEmployeesByUserRole
methods.description: Retrieves employees associated with a specific user role.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Verifies user credentials and retrieves the user if valid.

methods.name: checkPasswordHash
methods.description: Verifies if a password matches a stored hash.

methods.name: checkForOldHash
methods.description: Checks password against an older hashing method (MD5).

methods.name: getUndeletableUserIds
methods.description: Returns user IDs that cannot be deleted, such as current admin or default admin in demo mode.
